A vacation on Syngia moon! Not so, I lie! Mining, of course.''"<br />"''But I'm not a miner.|Guerra Derida, to Obi-Wan Kenobi|<ref name="TDR" />}}
The '''Syngia moon''' was a [[Moon/Legends|moon]] located in the [[Syngia system/Legends|Syngia system]] of the [[Sertar sector/Legends|Sertar sector]],<ref name="EAOC" /> in the [[Trans-Hydian/Legends|Trans-Hydian]] portion of<ref name="Region" /> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="TEA" /> It lay on the [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] known as the [[Shaltin Tunnels/Legends|Shaltin Tunnels]], which connected it to the [[Lianna system/Legends|Lianna]] and [[Zygerria system/Legends|Zygerria systems]].<ref name="TEA" />

==History==
{{Quote|What world ''is'' this, anyhow?|Han Solo's thoughts|<ref name="RD">''[[Rebel Dawn]]''</ref>}}
The Syngia moon was mentioned as a holiday destination by [[Guerra Derida]] to [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]].<ref name="TDR" /> It was also the site of [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo's]] blowout party.<ref name="RD" /><ref name="Atlas">{{Blog|danwallace|153|Unstated Canon in Star Wars: The Essential Atlas}}</ref><ref name="Atlas2">{{JCFCite|url=posts/31298680|board=Literature|thread=The Essential Atlas and Galactic Cartography: Official Discussion|user=[[Jason Fry|jasonfry]]|date=2010-10-10|time=8:39 PM|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20180219145450/http://boards.theforce.net/threads/the-essential-atlas-and-galactic-cartography-official-discussion.21938930/page-153|quote=Han whoops it up on the Syngia moon.}}</ref>
